title: Integrated Routing and Trajectory Design for Satellite Servicing
summary: This paper studies the integrated spacecraft routing and trajectory optimization problem for satellite servicing missions involving partial en-route propellant replenishment. Unlike terrestrial routing problems, spacecraft operate in a dynamic environment, and we need to optimize the spacecraft routing over a network with nonlinear and time-dependent trajectory costs. In this paper, we tackle this problem using two different formulations.
